payload.detail: UPDATE 2026-09-25 (PR #3019): the dishonest badge is fixed — Best fit now shows only when every non-stopword query token (plural-normalised) matches the record (src/lib/service-best-fit.ts). Ranking was deliberately not touched (src/lib/catalog-search.ts is a flagged ranking surface), so an eating-disorder record can still appear for panic disorder, unbadged. Remaining: the OR-token ranking itself, which needs the ranking-protection process and a canary.
